pb_duel_no_reward: No more rewards today for duels with this rival (or you hit the daily duel cap)
pb_raid_catch: The hunt prize is at your feet! Open it with the camera.
pb_gym_free: Free: the first to leave a critter takes it for their club
pb_pick_team: Pick your club. It is forever.
pb_team_level: At level %s you can pick a club and fight in arenas.
pb_gym_far: Get closer to the arena to defend it or fight.
pb_duel_hint: Challenge someone within %s m. If they accept, the battle starts.
pb_trade_hint: To trade you must be together, within %s m.
pb_trade_rule: If anyone changes their offer, both must confirm again. Epics, the legendary and variants have a daily limit.
pb_defender_back: Your defender is back from %s: +%s DNA and +%s nets
err_pb_defending: It is busy: defending an arena or on an expedition
err_pb_bad_team_pick: Choose your own critters that are not defending
err_pb_bad_switch: You can't switch to that one
err_pb_rival_gym: That arena belongs to another club
err_pb_already_defending: You already have a defender here
err_pb_not_rival: It does not belong to a rival club
err_pb_trade_limit: You have made all your trades today
err_pb_trade_special_limit: You already traded something special today
err_pb_trade_level: Your level is too low to trade this
err_pb_trade_incomplete: You both need to put something
err_pb_train_limit: You've trained as much as you can today
err_pb_needs_special_net: This critter can only be caught with a special net
pb_vanished_stock: It vanished: none left on the server
pb_blocked: It shielded itself! The net bounced
pb_dodged: It jumped out of the way!
pb_welcome_text: Go out and catch critters. The more you play, the higher your level, and with it come better critters, new nets and new things in the shop.
pb_welcome_1: Critters appear around you depending on the area and the time
pb_welcome_2: Level up to catch the rarest ones and improve your critters
pb_welcome_3: Duels, arenas, hunts and trades with people nearby
pb_alias_rule: 3 to 16 letters or numbers (also _ . -). Others see it and it cannot be changed.
pb_welcome_kit: You start with 20 nets and 3 baits.
pb_shop_hint: Basics are paid with bank money. The good stuff, with scales: earned by playing (first catch of the day, new species, arenas, hunts and levelling up).
pb_unlock_equipo: Pick a club and fight in arenas
pb_bicho_at_cap: It has reached your level cap (%s). Level up so it can keep growing.
pb_learn_pick: Pick the new move (replaces the second charged move)
pb_bag_full_stop: Your bag is full: what did not fit stayed at the bait station
pb_special_net_only: Can only be caught with the %s
err_pb_bad_alias: That name is not valid: 3 to 16 letters or numbers
err_pb_already_registered: You already have an angler name
err_pb_alias_taken: Another angler already has that name
err_pb_aquarium_full: Your aquarium is full: release a critter or upgrade it in the shop
err_pb_item_level: Your level is too low to use that
err_pb_too_strong: This critter is too strong for your level
err_pb_special_only: That net only works on the legends that need it
err_pb_other_level_low: The other person is not high enough level for that
err_pb_shop_limit: You have bought as many of those as you can for now
err_pb_bag_full: It does not fit in your bag
err_pb_bicho_cap: Your critter is already at your level cap
err_pb_max_rank: That move is already maxed out
err_pb_bicho_level: Your critter needs a higher level for that
pb_signal_dist: About %s away · look with the camera
pb_camera_hint: Tap a critter in range to catch it · Alt: look around
pb_camera_hint_aim: Aim with the crosshair and press Enter · Alt: back to cursor
pb_aim_hint: Put a critter inside the crosshair
pb_following: Following: GPS point and a light at the spot
pb_arrived: You are there: look with the camera
pb_task_nueva: Catch a species you do not have
pb_tasks_bonus: Do all three and also get
pb_tasks_all_done: All three done! +%s scales and a gift
pb_tasks_hint: Tasks change every day at midnight.
pb_ranking_arenas: Arenas held by each club right now
pb_tuto_1: Green ripples on the map are signals: something is moving there. You do not know what until you go.
pb_tuto_2: Open the camera and look around: critters are seen through the phone, where they are.
pb_tuto_3: Cast the net with the right power and reel it in without breaking it: pull too hard and the line snaps.
pb_tuto_4: Tap your level to see daily tasks, your medals and the ranking.
pb_cast_hint: Hold the net and release when the bar is in the green band
pb_reel_hint: Hold to reel in · release if it gets too tight
pb_short: Short: the net fell before it
pb_bait_pick: Pick one of the three crates
pb_exp_hint: Send up to 3 critters somewhere for a few hours. They come back with nets, baits, scales, DNA and experience. If they match the place's type, they bring more.
pb_exp_sent: On their way! They come back when the time is up
pb_exp_bonus: They were on home ground: they brought more
err_pb_exp_full: All your expeditions are already running
pb_tournament_hint: The strongest catch from Monday to Sunday. Prizes: %s, %s and %s scales.
pb_tournament_empty: Nobody has caught anything this week yet
pb_tournament_won: You finished #%s in the tournament! +%s scales
